name: Crowhaven
source:
In Crowhaven, you play as a young doctor, fresh out of his residency and eager to start a new life in a new town, doing the job you love the most. You are hired as a family doctor in a town called Crowhaven, in a brand-new clinic, working alongside two beautiful nurses (who happen to be sisters). You're glad to get away from your old life and start fresh, leaving behind bad memories and relationships that have run their course. Here you get to meet new people, get close to them if you wish, and enjoy your life...

But there's something a bit off about this town. It starts with a strange dream, then an even stranger event that makes you start asking questions about what's really going on. You slowly start noticing things that make you suspicious, and before you know it, you become entangled in a deep and disturbing mystery in a town full of secrets. However, some mysteries are better looking than others. There are a lot of beautiful girls in Crowhaven that can take your mind off of things, and who knows, perhaps even start a love story, or at the very least, satisfy your carnal desires.
translation:
在《Crowhaven》中，你扮演一名年轻的医生，刚结束住院医师实习，渴望在新城镇开始新生活，做你最喜欢的工作。你被聘为克罗黑文镇一家全新诊所的家庭医生，与两名漂亮的护士（恰好是姐妹）一起工作。你很高兴摆脱旧的生活并开始新的生活，留下不好的记忆和已经结束的关系。在这里你可以结识新朋友，如果你愿意的话可以接近他们，享受你的生活……

但这个小镇有点不太对劲。它从一个奇怪的梦开始，然后是一个更奇怪的事件，让你开始询问到底发生了什么。你慢慢地开始注意到让你怀疑的事情，在你意识到之前，你在一个充满秘密的小镇中陷入了一个深刻而令人不安的谜团。然而，有些谜团比其他谜团更好看。克罗黑文有很多美丽的女孩可以让你忘却一切，谁知道呢，甚至可能会开始一段爱情故事，或者至少满足你的肉欲。
